events.description:
Runs the export. While its promise is pending the export button shows a spinner and a progress bar runs above
the footer; when it resolves the button turns into a done tick and the dialog closes; when it rejects the dialog
stays open with an error. Call `progress` with the share done, from 0 to 1, to fill the bar; never called, the bar
stays indeterminate.
events.name: onExport
events.type: (request: ExportRequest, progress: (fraction: number) => void) => void | Promise<unknown>

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The file formats (CSV, Excel, PDF); the first is chosen unless `defaultValue` says otherwise.
props.name: formats

props.description: The columns the user may leave out, all ticked at first. Left out, there is no column picker.
props.name: columns

props.description:
The row count of each scope on offer; a scope without a count is not offered, and one with 0 rows is disabled.
The narrowest scope with rows is chosen first, so a selection is exported when there is one.
props.name: counts

props.description: The deliveries on offer; with one, there is no picker. Defaults to `["download"]`.
props.name: deliveries

props.description: The address an emailed export goes to, shown beside the email choice.
props.name: email

props.description: The element that opens the dialog; left out, the app opens it through `isOpen`.
props.name: trigger

props.description: The dialog's title; defaults to the catalogue's "Export".
props.name: title

props.description: One sentence under the title: what is being exported.
props.name: description

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen
